plan: Drive: from City of Campbell River, about 156 km (straight line times 1.3, estimate).
Park: 51.081, -125.58823, pull off on an unnamed gravel road. Map links below.
Walk: 7.0 km W, cross country, no trail mapped. Climb about 1,257 m, about 266 min at 3 km/h.
Camp: flat ground 340 m NW of the spot at 119 m (51.06931, -125.68935). Water: unnamed wetland 130 m E (estimate).
Hunt: ducks, Jan, Oct, Nov, Dec (season rows). Set up on the shore with the wind at your back: ducks land into the wind (Tip). Shoot only birds you can retrieve.
Use: 12 gauge, steel 2 to 4 (non toxic shot only), modified or improved cylinder rated for steel, plugged to 3 shells (regs).
Legal: MU (Management Unit) 1-15, Region 1. Season rows below. Study aid only. The official regulations are the law.
Verify: Candidate, scout it first. Check posted signs. Private land can be unsigned. Data dates: roads 2026-10-16, private land 2026-10-09, closures 2026-10-16.
R1D-duck-backcountry-0001.popWhy: Less popular (quieter): MU 1-15: about 2,613 hunter days a year for all big game (2020 to 2024 mean), 0.31 days per square km, bottom third of BC MUs; access: more than 5 km from a drivable road. Estimate, about 50% sure (my pick).
